verdict.rationale: Lithic docs show card creation, per-card Authorization Rules (merchant category, transaction limits, velocity) and spend limits, which support tightly scoped card controls, but no explicit documentation of a native 'single-use' card type or exact-amount lock — this is approximated via combining spend limits and merchant-category rules rather than a dedicated one-time-use mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit single-use/one-time card feature, exact-merchant-lock documentation, and independent confirmation that a leaked single-use card number is rendered worthless after one transaction.
